# gl_test case 4 (cull): the DCD Flags 0 bits Mesa sets for each of its six
# draws, and the r57 word (IDVS DCD0) they make. NOT a dump: no drm-shim was
# available on the host (docs/notes/mali-frame-formats.md section 1), so this
# is derived from Mesa 26.2.1's source and the board's flip dump, and is the
# prediction the board Mesa reference (modes cull-*) must confirm.
#
# Source:
#   pan_csf.c:1544-1559   cull_front_face = polygon && (cull_face & FRONT)
#                         cull_back_face  = polygon && (cull_face & BACK)
#                         front_face_ccw  = rast->front_ccw
#   st_atom_rasterizer.c:77-92   front_ccw = (FrontFace == GL_CCW), inverted
#                         for a Y-0-bottom framebuffer (an FBO, a texture)
#   st_atom_rasterizer.c:110-127 cull_face from CullFaceMode
# Board evidence for the base words (tools/mali/board-dump/flip-2026-10-19.txt):
#   a window (top-down pbuffer), GL front CCW, no cull:   r57 0x121AB  (bit 16 set)
#   an FBO,                      GL front CCW, no cull:   r57 0x0021AB (bit 16 clear)
#   DCD Flags 0 bit 16 Front Face CCW, bit 17 Cull Front Face, bit 18 Cull
#   Back Face (src/mali/genxml/v10.rs DcdFlags0). The other bits are flip's
#   triangle draw's (kill/ZS operations, aligned line ends); case 4's draw is
#   the same kind (flat colour, no depth, no blend), so they should not move.
#
# GlesDraw.cull is the winding of the culled faces in GL terms
# (src/gl/draw.rs map_cull: GL_BACK+CCW -> CW, GL_FRONT+CCW -> CCW,
# GL_BACK+CW -> CCW, GL_FRONT+CW -> CW), front_cw = glFrontFace(GL_CW),
# flip_y = a top-down target (a window), false for an FBO.
#
# frame  target  glFrontFace glCullFace  GlesDraw.cull  front_face_ccw cull_front_face cull_back_face  r57
1  window CCW BACK  CULL_CW   1 0 1  0x521AB
2  window CCW FRONT CULL_CCW  1 1 0  0x321AB
3  window CW  BACK  CULL_CCW  0 0 1  0x421AB
4  window CW  FRONT CULL_CW   0 1 0  0x221AB
5  fbo    CCW BACK  CULL_CW   0 0 1  0x421AB
6  fbo    CCW FRONT CULL_CCW  0 1 0  0x221AB
#
# The rule src/mali would apply (frame.rs DcdFlags0 at the dcd0 literal):
#   polygon         = prim is a triangle list, strip or fan (u_reduced_prim)
#   front_face_ccw  = front_cw != flip_y                       (already there)
#   cull_front_face = polygon && cull != NONE && ((cull == CW) == front_cw)
#   cull_back_face  = polygon && cull != NONE && !cull_front_face
# Points and lines are never culled (pan_csf.c:1549-1556).
